title: Pregnant Blend 2-Mix Duo #05 (가로 띠 3구역·물결 / 세로 띠 3구역·매끈)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large pregnant woman, far beyond any real person.

#1: Nigerian, in her late 50s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — and between them, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward, her waistline already soft and gently defined even without the pregnancy, now continuing that same soft fullness into the belly's round curve with no harsh transition anywhere. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter glowing on the cheekbones, bold shimmering gold and emerald eyeshadow blended out toward the temples, dramatic long lashes, sharply defined brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong glossy fuchsia-pink lip, a bright, joyful smile, rich chocolate-brown hair styled in twin-tail, real pores, real living eyes, ears bare, no piercings, wearing two to three pieces of gold a ring. Painted in 2 different traditional patterns repeated across 3 regions of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 horizontal bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 22% of the way down her figure from the top and about 61% of the way down her figure from the top. The regions alternate between 2 patterns in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it is painted in Swedish Dalarna kurbits folk painting (a deep barn-red ground with bold cream and gold curling scrollwork), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with curling floral scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in American Art Deco chrome-and-lacquer (a deep black lacquer ground with bold silver chrome sunburst), wide silver chrome bands following the contours of the body, with zigzag linework filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything below the last transition zone: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, chin level, calm commanding presence, her extreme platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Thai, in her late 30s, cool and composed expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust, and dominating her entire middle, an enormous taut, high, rounded pregnant belly, far larger and more prominent than any ordinary pregnancy, projecting forward dramatically, the navel pushed outward on its smooth rounded surface. Enormous round hips below it, gigantic soft thighs, very thick soft arms. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive rounded middle. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, flawless pale-golden skin, sharply defined dark brows, a precise black winged liner with a strong flick, warm brown-bronze eyeshadow, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strong contour under the cheekbones, deep red glossy lips with a crisp edge, a poised, dramatic expression, rich chocolate-brown hair styled in sleek straight, real pores, real living eyes, 15 clicker rings piercings set with rubies in silver-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of platinum a necklace. Painted in 2 different traditional patterns repeated across 3 regions of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 vertical bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 27% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 58% of the way across her figure from her left edge. The regions alternate between 2 patterns in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it is painted in Polish Bolesławiec pottery (a deep cobalt ground with bold white peacock-eye dot motifs), wide white bands following the contours of the body, with peacock-eye dot motifs filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Filipino Yakan painted pattern (a black ground densely patterned with bright geometric diamond bands), wide magenta-and-gold bands following the contours of the body, with geometric diamond work filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even course. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, chin level, calm commanding presence, her extreme platform clear heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
